qa_pairs.question: What chapter number covers Body repair procedures?
What is the scope of the body jobs on convertibles section?
qa_pairs.answer: This section only describes special repairs for convertibles. Repairs which are identical or practically identical with those for sedans and/or four wheel drive models are not described here.

qa_pairs.question: What page reference is given for side member cover replacement with rear side panel and door pillar removed?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-101C is referenced for side member cover replacement with rear side panel and door pillar removed.

qa_pairs.question: What component replacement is covered on page 41-104C?
qa_pairs.answer: Side member cover partial replacement from door pillar, left or right, with rear side panel removed is covered on page 41-104C.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two trunk floor plate replacement procedures listed?
qa_pairs.answer: The two trunk floor plate replacement procedures are: partial replacement in front of cross member (replace tail panel removed) on page 41-107C, and partial replacement behind cross member (replace tail panel removed) on page 41-111C.

qa_pairs.question: What page covers front door pillar replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Front door pillar replacement (left or right, with front side panel removed) is covered on page 41-201C.
